_comment: Machine-readable venue profiles used by paper-to-latex/scripts/check_page_limit.py and paper-writer. Human-readable rationale and sources: venue_profiles.md. 'limit' = submission main-content pages. Re-verify against the official call for the target year before submission; 'status' records what was verified and when.

default-4.name: User default: 4-page workshop-style paper
default-4.status: User default (global CLAUDE pipeline). Not a venue rule.

neurips-workshop-4.name: NeurIPS workshop short paper (typical)
neurips-workshop-4.status: Limits are set per workshop (e.g. MechInterp@NeurIPS 2025: short <=4, long <=9). Always confirm the specific workshop CFP.

neurips.name: NeurIPS main track
neurips.stats_expectation: Paper checklist asks whether results supporting main claims have error bars, CIs or significance tests, with sources of variability and std vs s.e. stated; may be in tables or plots, explained in text.
neurips.status: NeurIPS 2026 CFP + official kit verified 2026-10-17: 9 pages incl. figures; refs, checklist, appendices excluded.

icml.name: ICML main track
icml.status: ICML 2026 CFP/author instructions verified 2026-10-17: 8 pages main body; references, impact statement, appendices unlimited; over-limit auto-rejected.

iclr.name: ICLR main track
iclr.status: ICLR 2026 author guide verified 2026-10-17: <=9 pages main text at submission, 10 at rebuttal/camera-ready; references unlimited; appendices after bibliography.

cvpr.name: CVPR main track
cvpr.status: CVPR 2023-2025 official: 8 pages incl. figures/tables, extra pages only for references; 2026 assumed same (verify).

iccv.name: ICCV main track
iccv.status: ICCV 2025 official: 8 pages excluding references; over-limit rejected without review.

eccv.name: ECCV main track
eccv.template: official kit (eccv (2026 kit, tag Latest)), downloaded 2026-10-17
eccv.status: ECCV 2026 policy: 14 pages incl. figures/tables, LNCS; reference-only pages exempt (policy wording slightly inconsistent; confirm with author kit). Kit text: 14 pages + additional pages for references; reference section not counted.

aaai.name: AAAI main technical track
aaai.stats_expectation: Reproducibility checklist: number of runs per result; measures of variation beyond single summaries; significance judged with appropriate tests (e.g. Wilcoxon signed-rank). Satisfied in paper or referenced technical appendix.
aaai.status: AAAI-26 verified 2026-10-17: up to 7 pages technical content + pages only for references and reproducibility checklist. Check AAAI-27 call.

aaai27.name: AAAI-27 main technical track
aaai27.status: AAAI-27 kit downloaded 2026-10-17; 7-page limit carried over from AAAI-26, verify in the AAAI-27 call.

aistats.name: AISTATS
aistats.status: AISTATS 2026 CFP verified 2026-10-17: 8 pages excl. references, reproducibility checklist, appendices (9 camera-ready).

uai.name: UAI
uai.status: UAI 2026 submission instructions verified 2026-10-17: main part <= 8 pages; references and appendices unlimited, appendices start on a new page.

ijcai.name: IJCAI-ECAI main track
ijcai.status: IJCAI-ECAI-26 kit text: max 7 pages + at most 2 for references/acknowledgements/contribution/ethics statements; appendices in the paper COUNT toward the limit.

acl-long.name: ACL / EMNLP / NAACL long paper (ARR)
acl-long.status: ACLPUB formatting verified 2026-10-17: long 8 pages content + unlimited references; Limitations section required and not counted.

acl-short.name: ACL / EMNLP / NAACL short paper (ARR)
acl-short.status: ACLPUB formatting verified 2026-10-17: short 4 pages content + unlimited references; Limitations section required and not counted.

tmlr.name: TMLR (journal)
tmlr.status: TMLR has no hard page limit; 12 is a soft target (longer papers need justification). Treat OVER_LIMIT as advisory.

colm.name: COLM
colm.status: COLM 2026 kit text: strict 9 pages main text at submission; unlimited pages for citations.

_kits: Official style kits: ~/.claude/skills/paper-writer/templates/venues/_downloads (SOURCES.json has URLs + sha256).
